study_identification_part.si_4_title: Neurodevelopmental model of schizophrenia revisited: similarity in individual deviation and idiosyncrasy from the normative model of whole-brain white matter tracts and shared brain-cognition covariation with ADHD and ASD

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: A large-sampled single-site harmonized cross-sectional MRI dataset from National Taiwan University Hospital (NTUH) was used.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Herein, we developed the normative model of WM microstructural property (generalized fractional anisotropy, GFA), as a function of age, across the lifespan using large-sampled single-site harmonized cross-sectional MRI data from more than 600 typically developing individuals (5-40 yrs) [17].

answer.SINGLE-SITE: normative training and testing (626 TDCs); patients for clinical research (281 Schizophrenia, 175 ASD, 279 ADHD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: 626 typically developing controls (TDC) were used to construct the normative model. Clinical groups (281 Schizophrenia, 175 ASD, and 279 ADHD) were used to investigate deviations and idiosyncrasies from the norm.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Sex-specific WM tract normative development was modeled from diffusion spectrum imaging of 626 typically developing controls (5-40 years). ... Individual deviations from the norm ... were then determined for around 300 individuals with schizophrenia, 300 with ADHD, and 200 with ASD.

model-1.model-name: sex-specific WM tract normative development model

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: 626 typically developing controls (TDC) were used for construction of the models. No explicit split into training and testing sets for the normative model development is mentioned, indicating the entire sample was used for model estimation via a moving average approach.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: Sex-specific WM tract normative development was modeled from diffusion spectrum imaging of 626 typically developing controls (5-40 years). ... constructed from 626 TDCs (Male/Female: 376/250; age range 5-40, 20.16 ± 8.5 yrs)
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: Chien2022.pdf.md: Abstract / Statistical analysis, standardized normative models
